title: What's New: Server and Database - A Faster Runtime (2023 release wave 2)

chapters.title: Error Info, Secret Text, and Permissions Improvements
Session Creation and Tenant Startup Performance

features.name: Error Info Add Action Method with Tooltip Support
features.description: The error info data type's add action method now supports adding a tooltip as the fourth parameter, allowing users to get further information about actions from the error dialogue.
caveats: Requires checking if on-premises functions have proper permissions before showing actions

features.name: Error Info Permission Checking
features.description: The add action method now checks if you try to call an un-premises function and simply does not show the action if the user does not have permission to interact with it.

features.name: Secret Text Data Type
features.description: A new secret text type has been added for handling passwords and other sensitive information, ensuring sensitive data is never exposed in memory dumps or debugging environments.
caveats: Covered in more detail in the What's New in AL session

features.name: Permissions Work with Security Groups
features.description: The effective permissions page now includes permissions gained through membership of a security group, improving how permissions interact with security groups.

features.name: Query UI and Data Analysis
features.description: Queries now have a new UI that allows for data analysis and can be used as run objects, enabling queries to open from actions on pages and be placed in the reporting section.
caveats: Queries are expected to gain additional capabilities in the future

features.name: Exclusive Time Telemetry
features.description: Partner telemetry now distinguishes between total time and exclusive time for AL calls, where exclusive time is the actual runtime without suspended time from other threads or sessions, calculated by subtracting suspended time from total time.
caveats: Available in both exclusive time and exclusive time in milliseconds

features.name: Session Creation Performance Improvement
features.description: Session creation is now 2 to 4 milliseconds faster by caching the companies that a user has access to, eliminating the need to recalculate this for each new session creation. For web services, this represents a 20-25 percent improvement in throughput.
caveats: Most significant for web services and high-volume operations

features.name: Tenant Startup Performance
features.description: Tenant mounting and startup is now significantly faster through optimized event subscriber hooking, resulting in up to a thousand times faster startup on busy nodes with many tenants and reduced memory usage.
caveats: Benefit primarily visible for on-premises solutions with multiple customers
